state_and_units.D: local exchangeable/translocatable phosphorus amount in mol elemental-P equivalent
state_and_units.E: local immobile growth-precursor phosphorus amount in mol elemental-P equivalent
state_and_units.structural_p: cumulative nonmobile amount in mol elemental-P equivalent

reaction.technical_step_rule: requested forward and reverse amounts are R*dt from the same pre-reaction state; each is independently capped at its prestate donor amount; both accepted transfers commit simultaneously

liebig_growth.accepted_delta_V: min(requested_delta_V, N_B/q_B, N_E/q_P, native admissible geometric allowance)
liebig_growth.state_time: C_B, C_E, N_B, and N_E are evaluated after membrane transfer and local reactions and before growth
liebig_growth.geometry_rule: derive the native fungal tip/interior cylinder geometry for the accepted volume from the pre-growth geometry; a geometry-ineligible segment accepts zero growth
liebig_growth.atomic_commit: only accepted delta_V commits; debit q_B*delta_V from B, debit q_P*delta_V from E, and credit exactly the E debit to structural_p
liebig_growth.rejection_rule: rejected, clipped, geometry-ineligible, or unrealized growth consumes neither B nor E

integration_policy.feature_off: the frozen legacy chemistry kernel is called byte-identically with its original parameter vector
integration_policy.feature_on: for fungal particles only, legacy B-driven growth and legacy inert-P growth limiting are disabled inside the frozen kernel; legacy membrane/carbon reactions finish first, then this contract applies D/E reaction and Liebig growth once per global O02 transaction
integration_policy.nonfungal_particles: retain frozen legacy behavior and do not consume D/E through P13
integration_policy.F: every F reaction coefficient and transfer remains exactly zero

numerical_policy.roundoff_clamp: only negative values within the existing P10 integrated tolerance may clamp to zero; every clamp is counted and reported
numerical_policy.conservation: existing P10 local and integrated tolerances are unchanged
numerical_policy.timestep_and_grid: C13 Stage 0 must qualify convergence prospectively before any P15 science run

required_cases: rejected growth consumes no B or E
claim_boundary: P13 software and numerical behavior only under a provisional user-adopted contract; not mentor approval, calibration, predictive validity, a selected biological baseline, or C12+ authorization.
